query:
INSERT INTO sections (id, project_id, name, position, color, created_at)
                        VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6)
                        ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET
                            project_id = EXCLUDED.project_id,
                            name = EXCLUDED.name,
                            position = EXCLUDED.position,
                            color = EXCLUDED.color
